Decision: Can we commit to this spend?
Minimum fields: Cash balance; expected receipt dates and amounts; committed payables; payroll; proposed payment amount and date; 13-week forecast
Source of truth: Bank account plus receivables/payables and cash sheet
Rule or calculation: Rebuild the dated 13-week cash flow with the proposed payment on its expected payment date; compare the revised lowest balance with the business cash floor
Trigger: The revised forecast low point falls below the cash floor; if it stays above the floor this trigger does not fire
Next action: Defer, split or fund the payment, or chase a specific receipt; then update the forecast
Outcome to record: Proposed payment amount and date; revised low point; cash floor; actual payment date; decision taken
Caveat: A current bank balance is not a cash forecast

Minimum fields: Invoice ID; amount; due date; days overdue; last contact; promise-to-pay; dispute status
Source of truth: Invoice ledger reconciled to bank receipts
Rule or calculation: Age outstanding invoices by due date and amount
Trigger: A material invoice is overdue or a promised payment date is missed
Next action: Contact the buyer; resolve the dispute; record the next follow-up date
Outcome to record: Payment date and amount; next commitment; unresolved blocker
Caveat: Age buckets organise follow-up but do not predict which customer will pay

Minimum fields: SKU; opening available quantity; each confirmed receipt quantity and expected date; forecast demand by date; supplier lead time; safety stock
Source of truth: Stock ledger plus open purchase orders and supplier receipts
Rule or calculation: For each date, projected stock = opening stock - cumulative forecast demand due by that date + confirmed receipts due on or before that date; count each receipt only from its expected arrival date
Review cadence: Daily for fast-moving stock; weekly for slower items
Trigger: Projected stock falls below safety stock before a new order could arrive; a later receipt does not offset an earlier shortage
Next action: Verify physical count and each supplier ETA; reorder or expedite before the projected breach
Outcome to record: Daily projected versus actual stock; receipt dates and quantities; stockout or excess stock; reorder decision
Caveat: Forecast error and supplier reliability change the safety stock required; confirm ETAs rather than assuming every open PO arrives on time

Minimum fields: Account ID; last order or meaningful use; normal repeat cycle; unresolved issue; last contact
Source of truth: Order system; CRM; support log; or product events
Rule or calculation: Compare days since last activity with that segment's normal cycle
Trigger: A customer is quiet beyond the normal cycle for that segment
Next action: Ask what changed and remove the specific blocker
Outcome to record: Repeat order or use; churn; next follow-up date
Caveat: Do not apply one inactivity window to seasonal and recurring buyers

Minimum fields: Cohort; account or user ID; named outcome event; step events; errors; support-assisted flag; time to value
Rule or calculation: Compare step conversion and time to value across comparable cohorts
Trigger: A service level or comparable cohort worsens against its own baseline
Next action: Inspect the failing step; assign an owner; test one change
Outcome to record: Completion rate; time to value; repeat use; support burden
Caveat: Define the value event first; page views and sign-ups are not automatically value

Decision: Does this price still earn its keep?
Minimum fields: Plan; list price; discount; net collected; payment fee; variable delivery cost; support hours; refunds
Rule or calculation: Contribution margin = (net receipts - variable delivery costs) / realised price
Review cadence: Monthly or after a material fee or cost change
Trigger: Contribution margin falls below the target for that customer segment
Next action: Change price; package; segment; or service promise
Outcome to record: Contribution by cohort; renewal; refund; support cost
Caveat: Do not infer willingness to pay from compliments or an untested survey
